title: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Lahore 2026
description: A one-day Hacktoberfest hackathon in Lahore, organised by CNSPK and listed by Major League Hacking. Teams built open-source AI projects and submitted them to MLH prize categories.
summary: A one-day build event run by CNSPK as part of Hacktoberfest 2026, listed on Major League Hacking under the theme “AI for Everyone”. Students and developers worked in teams on open-source and open-weight AI projects, and submissions were judged in two MLH prize categories: Best Open-Source AI Project (DigitalOcean) and Best Use of Gemma 4 (Google DeepMind).

summary: A Hacktoberfest 2026 gathering at the University of Lahore for students taking their first steps into open source. Farhan Ashraf presented “Open Source: AI for Everyone!”, a practical introduction to building with AI tools in open-source projects.

title: DevSecOps for All: How Open Source Can Kickstart Your Security Journey
venue: Lahore Garrison University, Main Campus, DHA Phase 6
description: A beginner-friendly session at CyberFest Lahore on breaking into DevSecOps with open-source tools.
summary: A one-hour session at CyberFest Lahore for students. It covered how modern teams build secure-by-design systems and how beginners can start contributing to open-source security tooling.

title: Networking Friday
description: An evening networking meetup for students and professionals working in cloud security and DevSecOps.
summary: An evening meetup organised in response to member feedback, mixing short discussions on cloud security and DevSecOps with time to meet other practitioners.

title: CloudSec Fusion: AI-Driven Defense
description: Sessions and demos on how AI-driven tools help predict, detect, and respond to threats in cloud environments.
summary: A CNSPK event on AI in cloud security: sessions, hands-on demos, and case studies on using AI-driven tooling to predict, detect, and mitigate threats in cloud-native environments, from analytics to automated response.

title: The Art of Recon
description: Reconnaissance for cloud-native security: OSINT, Google dorking, Shodan, and Nmap applied to containerised and serverless systems.
summary: A session on the role of reconnaissance in defending cloud-native systems. It walked through how security practitioners use OSINT, Google dorking, Shodan, and Nmap to find weaknesses in containerised, serverless, and microservice architectures before attackers do.

title: Decoding Cloud Native Security
description: An introductory session on securing cloud-native environments and DevSecOps strategy.
summary: An interactive introduction to securing cloud-native environments, with practical guidance on fitting security into DevSecOps workflows.

title: Security Fusion
description: A campus session on Kubernetes and how it automates deploying, scaling, and monitoring containerised applications.
summary: A campus session introducing Kubernetes: how it automates deploying, updating, scaling, and monitoring containerised applications, and why that matters for securing them.

title: Cloud Native Security Meetup Islamabad
description: CNSPK's first meetup in Islamabad, run with AWS Community Pakistan and hosted by SOFTOO.
summary: CNSPK's first meetup in Islamabad and its earliest event on record. It was run with AWS Community Pakistan and hosted by SOFTOO, as a networking evening for cloud and security practitioners.
